repository.name: delivery-fixture
repository.conventions: Recent subjects use Conventional Commits. There is no PR template and no required disclosure or sign-off trailer. Refs trailers accept an abbreviated hash with its subject.
repository.delivery: The change summary is the complete staged and PR diff. This is an inactive paper exercise; no commits, publishing, or activation occurred.

fixtures.change: Pin worker-lib from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4; no other lines change.
facts: Version 1.2.4 fixes retry handling under intermittent connection resets.
Revision aaa1111 reduced failed jobs by 35% in a Linux load test before the final pin change.
The final revision bbb2222 passed a retry smoke test on Linux x86_64; the load test was not repeated.
macOS was not tested.

fixtures.change: Convert 12 prose tables to grouped lists, remove a markdown table-padding lint guard, and move duplicated activation guidance into the shared command guide. No commands or runtime behavior change.
facts: Prettier rewrote 187 lines when only three table entries changed.
Tables used only for mappings remain tables.
The shared command guide still says the user runs local activation commands.
The changes affect global guidance, repo skills, and eval instructions; they share the same table-padding problem.
Start review with the shared command guide to check that activation boundaries survived.
Revision ccc3333 passed a semantic content comparison on the documentation; no runtime test was relevant.

fixtures.change: Add ExecStartPre=/bin/rm -rf %t/state to worker.service to remove stale startup state.
facts: Every restart now deletes cached state, including pending jobs; completed jobs remain in the database.
Operators must drain pending jobs before restarting; removing the new pre-start command stops further deletion but cannot restore already deleted jobs.
Upstream issue #87 reports the stale-state startup failure; this patch is a workaround and does not resolve the upstream issue.
The investigation included five restart attempts and two discarded approaches.
Revision ddd4444 passed a stale-state restart test on Linux x86_64; no live host has been activated.

fixtures.change: Add a Python3 build rule for status.py next to its existing Python2 rule.
facts: Consumers can reference the local Python3 rule instead of defining their own.
Keeping the rules together simplifies upcoming automated build-file refactoring.
There is no runtime state deletion, stored-format change, or host activation.
Revision eee5555 built the new rule on Linux x86_64; runtime behavior was not tested.

fixtures.change: Remove the pre-start state deletion from worker.service to restore pending-job retention across restarts.
facts: The deletion was introduced by commit 1a2b3c4, subject fix(worker): clear stale state before startup.
Pending jobs survive restarts again. Previously deleted jobs cannot be recovered by this fix.
Stale state is now rejected by the worker library, so the deletion workaround is obsolete.
Revision fff6666 passed the pending-job restart test on Linux x86_64; no live host has been activated.

fixtures.change: Write cache expiry timestamps in seconds instead of milliseconds; readers invalidate old millisecond timestamps.
facts: Old cache entries are invalidated on first read; the cache repopulates automatically.
Deploy readers that accept the new unit before writers; rolling back writers is safe while those readers remain deployed.
The rollout risks extra database reads while the cache warms; no performance improvement was measured.
Revision aaa7777 passed old-format invalidation and new-format round-trip tests on Linux x86_64.
No production rollout has happened.
